wish: someone should make an online designer for notepad book covers
spec:
Design a notebook cover: pick size (A6, A5, B5, Letter), colour, pattern, title and small line, optionally add a photo.
Type the text, tap options, watch the cover preview update, then download a 300 dpi PNG at the exact paper size.
It does not save images between visits, does not print, and has no spine or back cover.
notes: Image upload is read locally with FileReader; PNG export runs in the browser.
